description: AlphaFold pLDDT profile of FSH3 to establish which regions of the model are reliable for pocket measurement
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, networkx as nx
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import Delaunay, cKDTree
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, fcluster
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'P':1.80}
AA3=set('ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL'.split())
def parse_pdb(t):
    A=[]
    for l in t.splitlines():
        if l.startswith('ENDMDL'): break
        if not l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')): continue
        rn=l[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3 or l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        nm=l[12:16].strip(); el=(l[76:78].strip().upper() or nm[0])
        if el=='H' or nm[0]=='H': continue
        A.append((nm,rn,l[21],int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),el,float(l[60:66] or 0)))
    return A
t=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q99369-F1-model_v6.pdb',headers=H,timeout=120).text
at=parse_pdb(t)
pl={a[3]:a[8] for a in at if a[0]=='CA'}
res=sorted(pl); pld=np.array([pl[r] for r in res])
print('FSH3 pLDDT: mean %.1f  median %.1f'%(pld.mean(),np.median(pld)))
# contiguous low-confidence stretches
low=[r for r in res if pl[r]<70]
def runs(xs):
    out=[];s=None;p=None
    for x in xs:
        if s is None: s=x
        elif x!=p+1: out.append((s,p)); s=x
        p=x
    if s is not None: out.append((s,p))
    return out
print('pLDDT<70 stretches:',runs(low))
print('pLDDT<50 stretches:',runs([r for r in res if pl[r]<50]))
for r in [11,13,67,79,80,81,87,90,116,117,150,153,180,187,209,210]:
    print(f'  pLDDT {r}: {pl[r]:.0f}', end=' |')
print()

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,3))
ax.plot(res,pld,color='#2b6cb0',lw=1.2)
ax.axhline(70,color='grey',ls='--',lw=0.8)
for p in (117,180,209): ax.axvline(p,color='#c53030',lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel('FSH3 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title('AlphaFold confidence across FSH3 (AF-Q99369-F1 v6); red lines = catalytic triad S117/D180/H209')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
